messages:
Aisha: Heads-up: promo blocked, deploy-bot failed the canary job (artifact-upload).
deploy-bot: Promotion aborted: job `canary-integrations` failed (exit=1). Logs: https://ci.redwood/1746623333 :warning:
Ravi: Quick skim shows checksum-mismatch on multipart upload, looks like cache metadata drift.
Emma: Repro locally when using `redwood/builder:edge-2026-03`. Works with `redwood/builder:stable-2026-02`.
Aisha: We have a 90m change window starting soon. Options: pin promo to stable image or rollback the builder bump.
Ravi: Pinning seems lowest blast radius. We'll need follow-up to reconcile cache schema.
Emma: I'll open MR to pin the promo job to `redwood/builder:stable-2026-02` and trigger a rerun. ETA 15m.
ops-bot: Incident created: CI_UPLOAD_502. Acknowledge within 30m to avoid escalation.
deploy-bot: Retrigger requested by Emma — job queued.
Aisha: Add a short release-note: "Promo pinned to stable builder image due to artifact upload checksum drift; will re-verify after toolchain fix." Mark `requires-followup`.
Ravi: Also adding a short canary retry backoff in the pipeline.
Emma: MR posted: https://git.redwood/infra/ci/-/merge_requests/410 — starting canary rerun.
deploy-bot: Canary rerun started, step `artifact-upload` running.
Aisha: If rerun passes, promote and schedule post-release job to run full cache compatibility tests. If it fails, we'll consider delaying the window.
